causal_uncertainty: Both full-status snapshots for the final receive/send report zero peers, after prior agreement snapshots reported one peer each. This is evidence of a connectivity/state problem at observation time, not a diagnosis of why peers disappeared.
broadcast=true proves the sender action returned that flag, not that the receiver obtained the transaction.
No fresh full-status, peer, bridge, or resource samples occur inside the failed polling loop.
Fast negative lookup results do not distinguish genuine non-arrival from a false-negative observer/native-state defect.
The public evidence does not support attribution to randomness.

earlier_mempool_evidence.interpretation: Earlier per-transaction responses prove that positive mempool membership was observed, including near failure. All-zero periodic size samples cannot exclude between-sample membership. None establishes receipt of the final transaction.

deadline.qualification: payment() starts its clock just before receive(); the first dispatch is an event-level approximation, not an exact logged deadline

failure.detail: Receiver did not observe actual transaction relay before mining

latest_observations.sample_observation_limit: Resource and bridge samples precede the failed send; they do not prove state throughout its 60-second budget.

observer_growth_fix_assessment.different_failure_boundary: No mine action was dispatched for the failed payment; this is the pre-mining receiver-membership deadline, not the earlier F mine-response deadline.
observer_growth_fix_assessment.limitations: Final-hour p95/p99 were higher and the window includes upgrade/transport effects. These timings do not establish lookup correctness for the absent transaction, prove a long-run asymptotic bound, or locate the native/transport cause.
observer_growth_fix_assessment.supported: The bounded per-transaction observer avoided a history-sized response in the failing loop: all 481 replies were 148 bytes, all completed below 20 ms, and their combined action time was 6.778447467 seconds. First/final-hour medians remained in the same range despite wallet address counts growing from 3 to 1012.

polling_latency_comparison.method: Coordinator monotonic action_dispatched -> matching action completion; nearest-rank p95/p99. All-query rows also include post-mine confirmation queries. The final observed hour ends at the failure and includes the upgrade phase.
